snippet.title: Anomaly Center | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
After a wave of layoffs following a murder at the mall, you step in as the night security guard. The job is simple: catch shoplifters and stop anomalies from reaching safe limits. Just remember - DAC has its eye on you.

Howdy!
We're Polish indie developers, and we're working on a game about finding anomalies in a liminal shopping mall.
We can finally announce that our Steam page is now public!
Demo of game on Steam Next Fest: October 2026 
Release date of early access: 27 Oct, 2026

_______________________________________________________
